title: Transforming & Filtering Collections (lists:map/2, lists:filter/2, lists:filtermap/2)
solutionExplanation: Utilizes lists:map/2 for 1-to-1 price transformations, lists:filter/2 for status filtering, and lists:filtermap/2 for single-pass metric sanitization.

otpDocCards.description: Transforms every element in List1 by applying Fun, preserving length and order.
Calls Fun on elements of List1; returns List2 containing elements where Fun returned true or {true, Val}.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: Single-pass O(N) filtering and transformation avoiding intermediate lists.

mentalModelCheck.question: Why is lists:filtermap/2 preferred over lists:map(F, lists:filter(P, List)) in high-throughput Erlang servers?

options.label: It traverses the list exactly once and avoids allocating a throwaway intermediate list on the process heap
options.explanation: Chaining filter then map creates an intermediate list that immediately triggers garbage collection; filtermap builds the final result in a single pass.

options.label: lists:filtermap/2 executes concurrently across multiple BEAM schedulers
options.explanation: lists module functions are sequential and execute inside the calling process.

options.label: lists:map cannot operate on tuples
options.explanation: lists:map accepts any Erlang term, including tuples.
